children: pre-market contracts on Hyperliquid are down roughly 30% from their September highs as investors reined in expectations ahead of the AI startup’s planned initial public offering.

Trading in the ANT-USDC pair on the decentralized exchange reflects a sustained retreat from peaks near $2,400 hit two months ago. While a bounce to $1,695 at press time eases a sharper slide that briefly took the valuation proxy near $1,615 in early Monday trading, secondary market pricing continues to signal persistent caution surrounding the Claude maker's imminent listing.
On Friday, a day after markets endured a tech-led selloff, the pre-IPO contracts reached as low as ~$1,520.
